title: The lantern boat festival
alt: A glowing lotus lantern travels through a layered paper riverside festival.
description: A complete cut-paper world with one lantern boat, intricate pavilions and warm theatrical light.
prompt: An exquisite wide illustration of a riverside lantern festival made entirely from layered coloured paper. One long wooden-style paper boat glides along an indigo river, carrying a single tall lantern shaped like a luminous gold lotus. Its hull and reflection are coherent. On both banks, intricate red pavilions, arched bridges, folded trees and tiny lantern strings create a dense joyful scene. No people and no writing. Visible cut edges, paper fibres and theatrical warm light.
